band-stbd.what: starboard leading-edge glacis band seen from ahead and above, the Harpoon bay in its back (mirror of port)

pod-top-stbd.what: starboard gun nacelle deck from above: the armour coaming round the turret deck (mirror of port)

pod-out-stbd.what: starboard gun nacelle outboard wall, red armour in a bolted course (mirror of port)

pod-nose-port.what: port gun nacelle blunt chamfered nose from ahead

pod-nose-stbd.what: starboard gun nacelle blunt chamfered nose from ahead (mirror of port)
